sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: []{#sec:intro label="sec:intro"} This article is concerned with a case of mirror symmetry relating the algebraic geometry of a Fano manifold to the symplectic geometry of a Landau--Ginzburg model. The Fano manifold is the projective plane $\CP^2$ with homogeneous coordinates $x, y, z$, and additionally we choose as anticanonical divisor $D = C \cup L$, the union of a conic $C = \{xz-y^2\}$ and a line $L = \{y=0\}$
